title: Catch print problems before you slice
summary: Thingport now checks your models for the problems that ruin prints. You can also ask an AI assistant about your library, give Thingport your own colours (now in Spanish and French too), and tidy collections and tags in bulk.

items.title: Print quality checks
items.description: The first time you open a model, each STL, OBJ and 3MF file is checked for holes, non-manifold edges, flipped or inside-out faces, loose fragments, missing 3MF parts, damaged files and sizes that suggest the wrong unit. A tick or a warning appears next to 3D Preview. Click it for a report that explains each problem and how serious it is. Admins can turn the checks off, all at once or one at a time, under Administration → Rendering.

images.caption: Checking a model while you look at it
The report explains what each problem means

items.title: Ask an AI assistant about your library
items.description: Thingport speaks MCP, so Claude and other assistants can search and read your library ("which of my models are articulated dragons?") and, if you let them, import models into collections. Generate an API token in Profile, pick its tools under Token permissions, then connect. The Profile page shows this command with your address and token already filled in:
items.code: claude mcp add --transport http thingport https://thingport.example.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer tp_your_token"

images.caption: Allow or deny each tool per token

items.title: Your colours
items.description: Pick an accent in Configuration → Appearance: Thingport green, a new graphite, or a provider's brand colour. It recolours the app and its logo, and tints model renders, dashboard lists, tag tiles and the 3D preview. Renders can also have a colour of their own, and model cards can show 3D renders instead of photos for a uniform grid.

images.caption: Accent, render colour and model cards

items.title: Sort, select and merge collections and tags
items.description: Collections sort by newest, name or most models, and tags can now sort by newest. Select several to bookmark, delete or merge them. Before a merge, you see which one is kept, what is removed and which syncs stop.

images.caption: A merge shows what will change first

items.title: Español and Français
items.description: Thingport now speaks Spanish and French as well as English and Lithuanian. Pick a language at the top of Configuration → Appearance.

items.title: Choose what an API token can read
items.description: Dashboards and launchers such as Homarr read only the parts of your library you allow, set in the same Token permissions dialog. Existing tokens keep full access, so nothing that already uses one stops working.

items.title: Pictures and files stay with their model
items.description: A model's pictures, renders and supporting files now go in an Images folder next to its model files. They follow your storage template and move with the model. Existing libraries are moved over automatically on the first start.

items.title: MakerWorld models with only STL/CAD files
items.description: Listings with no print profiles, only the files behind "Download STL/CAD files", now import instead of failing.

items.title: Reset to defaults
items.description: Restore your appearance settings in one click, or reset categories to the starter tree after previewing exactly what changes.

items.title: What's new after every update
items.description: You're reading it. Open it again any time from your user menu.

items.title: Faster model listings: only the files on the page you're viewing are loaded
The dashboard's top providers show each provider's logo and name
AI assistants get your most used tags with their counts and can search them, instead of the whole list at once
Names with accents or non-Latin letters stay readable in zip downloads, and when the zip is imported back
Reasoning AI models no longer use up their budget thinking and cut their answer short
AI description suggestions for imported models are no longer lost while the import is still adding pictures
A theme or accent that fails to save goes back to your saved one
Editing tags at the same time from two places no longer loses changes
Many missing Spanish and French translations filled in
